Overview

Ulsan is a city in USN with a population of 1,139,000. Korea’s industrial powerhouse and the world’s largest shipbuilding center, home to Hyundai’s massive shipyard. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
